Good afternoon

We would like to kindly inform you that the owner of the apartment has requested a brief viewing of the unit on Wednesday, anytime between 12:00 PM and 4:00 PM.

The viewing will be very quick, and we will make every effort to ensure it causes minimal disruption to your stay.

May I kindly ask if this would be possible for you? If so, please let us know a convenient time within the above-mentioned window, so we can coordinate with the owner and arrange the viewing accordingly.

We sincerely appreciate your kind cooperation and understanding.
